verdict.rationale: Pendo's analytics page says it tracks and compares how users navigate the app to spot drop-off. The session-replay page refers to clicking a 'funnel drop-off', which implies a funnel feature exists. The filters in the pack belong to session replay, not funnels, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-step funnel building, funnel-specific filters, breakdowns by property or segment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build multi-step funnels with filters and breakdowns to find where users drop off

citations.quote: Track and compare how users navigate your app to spot drop-off and boost conversion.
Click a funnel drop-off, an NPS detractor, or a piece of feedback and watch the sessions behind it.
